name: Confluence of erasure (a branching episode)
description: From (P)(Q)(R), erase (P) and (Q) in either order — two lines of development that fork at the start and converge at (R). A native demonstration of branch-and-merge structure (the derivation-DAG view): every edge a real ERA application, so the whole DAG is attestable; the order-independence it shows is a local-confluence fact about erasure.
